<fidel-lesson-formats>

Choose how to take the lesson. Buttons for Watch, Listen, Read, Sign language and Simple words; only the formats the lesson has are offered, each with its download size.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Blind learners and learners on expensive data (Listen downloads no video), Deaf learners (Sign language), learners who find reading hard (Simple words), and anyone who prefers to read.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት። This example uses plain video files, so only Watch and Sign language are offered. A lesson from a Fidel server also offers Listen and Read.

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-lesson-formats for="lesson-player"></fidel-lesson-formats>
<fidel-player id="lesson-player" lesson="https://YOUR-FIDEL-HOST/api/v1/lessons/LESSON_ID"></fidel-player>

Source: player/src/components/e/lesson-formats.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-lesson-formats>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
forid of a <fidel-player>the first <fidel-player> on the pageThe player this component works with.
audioURLnoneAn audio-only file, if the player's lesson has none.
heading-level2 to 63Level of the component's heading, so it fits your page's outline.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-lesson-formats>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-lesson-format{ format } (watch, listen, read, sign, simple)The learner chose a format.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • The formats are real buttons with aria-pressed, in a group with a heading.
  • The choice is announced ("Listen mode: audio and transcript.") and remembered in this browser.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: The format choice is a labelled group.
  • 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: aria-pressed on each format button.
  • 4.1.3 Status Messages: Format changes are announced.
  • In Listen and Read, the <fidel-player> is taken out of the page (a comment keeps its place), so no video is downloaded. It comes back for the other formats.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
